cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down; I'll pour the tea. You asked how lunch was: the soup was excellent.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was before I asked who ate my birthday cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll cut you something else while we talk. The soup was a little salty, since you asked.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Stop offering food. Tell me what happened to the cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No food, then. As for lunch, next time I'd ask them to leave out the salt.

reason: Make the final safe answer develop the actual slight-salt finding rather than contradict the excellent-soup assessment.
